messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not use buspirone if you have taken an MAO inhibitor in the past 14 days. A dangerous drug interaction could occur. MAO inhibitors include isocarboxazid, linezolid, methylene blue injection, phenelzine, rasagiline, selegiline, and tranylcypromine.
Triplet: ["MAO inhibitors", "includes", "isocarboxazid"]

The relation 'includes' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject category contains or encompasses the specific entity specified by the object.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'include': The subject entity comprises or contains the component or measurement specified by the object entity.
B. 'is a type of': The subject entity is a specific type or subtype of the object entity.
C. 'involves buildup of': The subject condition involves the accumulation of the substance specified by the object entity.
D. 'passes into': The subject drug is transferred or present in the substance or medium specified by the object entity.
E. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
